sloka: सम्चितान्यस्य वित्तानि विविधानि सहस्रशः ।दस्युभिर्विप्रलुप्यन्ताम् यश्यार्योऽनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-४३॥
transliteration: samcitānyasya vittāni vividhāni sahasraśaḥ ।dasyubhirvipralupyantām yaśyāryo'numate gataḥ ॥2-75-43॥

translations.english: May that man's accumulated extensive posssessions of various kinds of wealth be snatched away by thieves in thousands of ways if he had counselled the exile of my esteemed brother
